title: A high-order multi-scale method and its convergence analysis for temperature-dependent nonlinear thermal radiation problems of composite structures
summary: Accurate prediction of the nonlinear radiation thermal transfer in composite structures with temperature-dependent properties is significant in high-temperature applications of the materials. This study establishes a high-accuracy multi-scale computational model incorporating novel high-order correction terms for the high-fidelity simulation of nonlinear thermal radiation in composite structures, enabling local balance preserving of heat quantity.
